task_name: Umbra Loft - After Dark event campaign
client_brief:
After Dark: a coherent poster and social campaign from six different nights

Umbra Loft's autumn programme needs to feel like a series, even though our six usable archive photographs were shot under six different lighting rigs. We want a strong two-colour and grain treatment that actually lives in the images, not a collection of unrelated pictures behind matching text.

Deliverables
1. After Dark poster direction: 3 named exports. The billing order follows the supplied list, and each poster direction bills every night of the autumn series with its date; every act name is typeset in the series type, and a recovered wordmark, where an act has one, appears with it rather than in place of it. The event information is readable.
2. Promoter pitch deck: 1 named export. The three directions are meaningfully distinct. The sequence explains the series identity, and the deck charts last season's average draw by month from umbra_room_specs.txt.
3. Night release post: 9 named exports. The date matches this event, and the post carries that night's act, support act, door time, set time and advance price, with one of the six archive photographs in the two-colour and grain treatment; the act name is typeset in the series type, and a recovered wordmark, where the act has one, appears with it rather than in place of it. The advance price is readable.

Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Permission restrictions in the owner's notes take precedence over inclusion in a source table.

Use the attached brand identity and the source files listed in the asset manifest. The output register defines exact filenames, pages, sizes and record bindings. Supporting previews are welcome but cannot replace those files.

brand_identity.sector: An independent two hundred and fifty capacity basement live music room programming a nine night autumn jazz and after dark series.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Founded 2021, a basement room under a former textile mill in Providence, Rhode Island, a small independent team.
brand_identity.about: Umbra Loft is a two hundred and fifty capacity basement room under an old mill in Providence, programming jazz and after dark nights for a crowd that finds us through friends and phones at eleven at night. This autumn we are running nine nights as one series rather than nine separate shows. It has to look like one thing, and it has to look like the room it actually is: dark, close and made by hand.
brand_identity.audience: A scene literate, discovery driven crowd aged twenty one to thirty five, reached almost entirely on a phone late at night, who read polish as inauthentic and reward work that plainly comes from the room.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Tickets 18 to 32 dollars, capacity 250. Independent basement scale: deliberately made and high contrast, credible at a headline ticket without ever reading as corporate or sponsored programming.

palette.name: Pitch
palette.usage: The main ground of every poster, post and deck page, and always the solid ground under an act block (type rule: Bone White on Pitch), as on umbra_seasoncard_autumn.pdf. Never type.

palette.name: Ash
palette.usage: A secondary solid panel only, such as the frame behind a photograph on umbra_seasoncard_autumn.pdf, or behind a table or chart in the deck. Never type and never the ground under an act block.

palette.name: Sodium
palette.usage: The date line directly above each act block (type rule and step 02), as on umbra_seasoncard_autumn.pdf; it may also set the advance price and hairline rules, as that card does. Never a ground or a panel.

palette.name: Cold Signal
palette.usage: Hairline rules, dividers and chart marks, or one of the two colours of a photograph's treatment. Never type, a ground or a panel.

palette.name: Bone White
palette.usage: Every act name (type rule: Bone White on Pitch), and every other line of type apart from the Sodium date line and advance price: titles, headings, support, door, set, body, billing, table and fine-print lines, as on umbra_seasoncard_autumn.pdf. Never a ground or a panel.

palette.name: Blood
palette.usage: Hairline rules, dividers and chart marks, or one of the two colours of a photograph's treatment. Never type, a ground or a panel.

brand_identity.typography: Umbra Loft runs four steps. Step 01, display, is Sora ExtraBold caps at 180 pt on 148 pt leading with -10 tracking, that leading being 0.82 of the size, and every act name is broken onto exactly two lines whatever its length so the block closes into one solid mass of caps, Bone White on Pitch; the post size is 150 px on 123 px by the same 0.82 rule. Step 02, subheading, is Sora ExtraBold caps at 46 pt on 50 pt with +20 tracking for the date line, set in Sodium directly above the act block. Step 03, body, is Archivo Narrow Regular at 11 pt on 15 pt, tracking 0, to a maximum of 65 characters, and billing and tables take the same setting. Step 04, fine print, is Archivo Narrow SemiBold caps at 9 pt on 13 pt with +30 tracking, reserved for the door line.
brand_identity.voice: Terse, atmospheric, unvarnished. It names the act, the night and the door and gets out of the way. Example line the brand would write: "Doors 8. Downstairs. Two sets, one room, cash on the night."
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: We build the look from our own archive, six photographs shot on six nights under six touring rigs, no two matching. Three headline acts sent their wordmarks only as photographs of tour shirts and a tote, which their managers say is all that survives. There is no defined palette, type or treatment yet, and last season's printed card exists only as the press PDF our printer returned.
brand_identity.values: Everything comes from this room, on these nights, and it should never look like a bank's jazz sponsorship.
brand_identity.signature_type_move: Every act name is set in Sora ExtraBold caps and broken onto exactly two lines whatever its length, with leading closed to 0.82 of the size so the two lines almost collide into one solid block.

type_system.text_face: Archivo Narrow Regular, SemiBold for the door line

scale.note: Act names, always caps and always broken onto exactly two lines whatever the length, shown here with the break marked by a slash. Leading is 0.82 of the size, so 148 pt at A2 and 123 px at the 150 px post size, closing the two lines into one solid block, Bone White on Pitch.
The date line, set in Sodium and always sitting directly above the act block. One line only, so the 0.82 leading of step 01 does not apply.

scale.sample: Nine nights, one series, downstairs under the mill.
scale.note: Billing and tables take the same setting, with figures aligned in their columns.
SemiBold is reserved for the door line. Everything else at this size stays Regular.

type_system.signature_move: The two line stack. Every act name is Sora ExtraBold caps broken onto exactly two lines whatever its length, with leading closed to 0.82 of the size, 148 pt at the A2 size of 180 pt and 123 px at the 150 px post size, so the lines almost collide into one solid block of squared caps with no air inside it, Bone White on Pitch with the date above in Sodium.
rules: Never set an act name on one line.
Every act name is caps, broken onto exactly two lines whatever its length, with leading closed to 0.82 of the size.
The act block is Bone White on Pitch, with the date directly above it in Sodium.
Archivo Narrow Regular sets billing and tables. SemiBold is reserved for the door line and sets nothing else.
Sora ExtraBold is display only. It never sets billing, tables or body.
Everything comes from this room, on these nights. It must never read as corporate or sponsored programming.

palette_rules.distribution: Grounds and panels are Pitch or Ash and nothing else; Pitch is the main ground and always the ground under an act block. Every act name is Bone White on Pitch with its date line directly above it in Sodium, as the type rules require. Every other line of type, titles, headings, support, door, set, body, billing, table and fine-print lines included, is Bone White; the advance price may be Sodium, as on umbra_seasoncard_autumn.pdf. Pitch and Ash are never type. Cold Signal and Blood are accents for hairline rules, dividers and chart marks only, together no more than 5% of the designed, non-photographic area, never type, a ground or a panel. Any palette colour may be one of the two colours of a photograph's treatment.
palette_rules.opacity: Every palette colour is used solid, at 100% opacity, for type, grounds, panels, rules, chart marks and recovered act wordmarks: no tint, transparency, gradient, shadow, glow or blend mode, and no scrim, gradient or overlay of any colour, black and white included, laid over a photograph. The translucent type and rule of last season's umbra_seasoncard_autumn.pdf (printed at 86%, 78%, 70% and 55% opacity) are not carried over. The one place two palette colours mix is inside a photograph, in its two-colour treatment.
palette_rules.forbidden: No colour outside the six palette hexes for type, grounds, panels, rules, chart marks, icons or recovered act wordmarks; a recovered act wordmark takes one solid palette colour. No sponsor logo or corporate partner mark, since the type rules forbid anything that reads as corporate or sponsored programming.
palette_rules.photography: Every photograph carries the series two-colour and grain treatment: rendered in two palette colours with visible grain, never in full colour, and the nine night release posts share one pair so six different rigs read as one series. Photographs are used as shot, with nothing generated, extended, added or painted in.
